title: Whole Hollow Arch and Six Port Flange Fender
description: One wholly newly authored complete static arch-fender-inspired inspection object. A single connected closed rubber-like material body forms two entire broad mounting foot flanges, two thick sloped arch legs and a continuous flat high crown, enclosing a genuine full-length open under-arch passage. The legs and feet are one inseparable complete conforming material boundary rather than separate boards or extracted curves. Three genuine square through-ports pierce each whole foot flange, six in total; the finite thickness and complete walls of every port are modeled. One complete flat wear pad rests on the entire broad central crown seat and remains a separately editable full part. Both broad foot flanges reach the ground without extra hidden support blocks; the full open arch is visible from both finished longitudinal ends. Unlike the laminated dock bumper, there is no stack of flat resilient strips between two mounting channels, repeated strip count or exposed horizontal strap. Unlike the laminated cylindrical bearing display, there are no alternating annular layers, centre core, outer cover or cut inspection quarter. Unlike the timber arch centering, there are no posts, ribs, fan webs or temporary frame: the one-piece hollow arch and its two perforated foot flanges define the entire body. All numerical body profiles, six ports and whole pad newly authored together; no old bumper, bearing, formwork arch, beam or block imported, cut or scaled. Two whole closed editable material meshes and two opaque constant untextured PBR roles, metre-style native Z up and whole horizontal envelope centred above two broad ground patches belonging to the same whole body; one prop zero scenes. Broad one-piece arch-fender and optional face-pad vocabulary only, not a replica of a manufacturer product, standard size or branded installation. The object is deliberately an unmounted dry component display: no quay wall, vessel, anchor bolts, steel face panel or installed mooring system is included. Square mounting ports and pad proportions are artistic, not a usable fastener pattern or bonded-joint specification. No material, rubber deformation, energy absorption, reaction force, shear resistance, berth compatibility, vessel contact, real fastening, load, fabrication, installation or marine safety capability made or verified. No rigging, animation or interaction.
